intro: At Scrabblescrew's Camp in Desolace, Smeed Scrabblescrew is expecting a caravan and wants five tamed kodos ready for it. You carry Smeed's kodo kombobulator out among the ancient, aged and dying kodos, and lead the ones it tames back to the camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bibbly thinks he is the only goblin in Desolace who knows how to make money. Well, the only caravan brave enough to travel these parts relies on me. Ever since I learned how to rejuvenate and control aged and dying kodos with my kodo kombobulator, the caravan owner Cork, Rigger, and I entered a partnership.
Take the kombobulator and use it on any ancient, aged, or dying kodos; it will jolt the beast into a tamed kodo and force it to follow you. Once you have a kodo tamed, bring it back to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The caravan will be here shortly; do you have the five new tamed kodos I was asking for?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Three, four, and five... Excellent, I ask for five tamed kodos and I get five tamed kodos... I am going to be rich... Yes, very rich! I hope to see the look on Bibbly's green face when he hears about my success!
